card.name: "or an" in NSAID anemia warning
card.fires_on: The word "an" (or the "or" before it) in the NSAID hematologic toxicity sentence: "fluid retention, or an incompletely described effect on erythropoiesis". Weaker hits appear at other spots where a blood-related word is likely to come next.

modes.label: NSAID anemia sentence
modes.description: The linking word "an" or "or" just before "incompletely described effect on erythropoiesis" in the anemia warning.
modes.example: Hematologic Toxicity Anemia has occurred in NSAID-treated patients. This may be due to occult or gross blood loss, fluid retention, or<< an>> incompletely described effect on erythropo

modes.label: Scattered other spots
modes.description: Isolated words in other text, such as "every" before "part of the globe", or part of a word before "hemorrhage".
modes.example: years, decisively affecting its destinies, religious, literary, scientific, social and political, or as an existing power whose influence and activity extend to<< every>> part of the globe. In the past

card.writes: It pushes up word starts like "hem" and "hemisphere", which fits blood- or globe-related words coming next.
card.plain: It fires on a small linking word in the NSAID anemia warning, just before the text moves on to blood-making effects.
